gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with Clearwater Bay Road running generally in a westerly direction for approximately 18,000 feet and terminating at its elevated junction with Tai Po Road near milestone 3¾ as shown coloured pink on plan No. R.K. 1163.

Road commencing at its junction with Tai Po Road, 250 feet south-east of milestone 3¾, winding through the hills generally in a northerly direction for approximately 900 feet and terminating at its junction with Lung Cheung Road as shown coloured blue on plan No. R.K. 1163. (Previous Gazette Notification No. 509 dated 5/4/1957 for this road is hereby cancelled).
